skills.name: Flick (Lighter)
skills.desc: Flick your work lighter at something. A tiny burst of fire. Long cooldown.

skills.name: Firebolt
skills.desc: Hurl a bolt of fire. Applies Burning.

skills.name: Flame Ward
skills.desc: A shield of fire absorbs damage.

skills.name: Kindle
skills.desc: Set objects alight: light, cooking, signals.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.desc: An exploding ball of fire.

skills.name: Flame Wave
skills.desc: A cone of rolling flame.

skills.name: Ember Darts
skills.desc: A fan of small burning darts.

skills.name: Combust
skills.desc: Detonate Burning on a target.

skills.name: Heat Ray
skills.desc: Channel a beam of heat.

skills.name: Lava Pool
skills.desc: Leave a pool of lava on the ground.

skills.name: Living Flame
skills.desc: Summon a flame that fights for you.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.desc: Engulf an area in fire.

skills.name: Cauterize
skills.desc: Burn your wounds shut: heal and stop bleeding.

skills.name: Ash Cloak
skills.desc: Wrap yourself in drifting ash.

skills.name: Flame Step
skills.desc: Dash through fire.

skills.name: Smoke Signal
skills.desc: Send up smoke: reveals, calls, marks.

skills.name: Pyre Sight
skills.desc: Passive: see heat.

skills.name: Gale Slash
skills.desc: Three blades of wind. Pushes enemies back.

skills.name: Updraft
skills.desc: Leap on a column of wind and glide forward.

skills.name: Deflect Winds
skills.desc: Swirling winds bat projectiles away and soak hits.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.desc: A spinning storm that drags enemies in.

skills.name: Tempest Burst
skills.desc: Blow everything away from you.

skills.name: Tailwind
skills.desc: The wind is at your back. Literally.

skills.name: Frost Shard
skills.desc: A shard of ice. Slows what it hits.

skills.name: Ice Barrier
skills.desc: A shell of ice that soaks damage and chills attackers.

skills.name: Chill Touch
skills.desc: A freezing breath that slows everything in front of you.

skills.name: Ice Nova
skills.desc: Freeze everything around you solid for a moment.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.desc: A localised snowstorm. Bring a coat.

skills.name: Frost Lance
skills.desc: A spear of ice that goes straight through several enemies.

skills.name: Spark
skills.desc: A crackling bolt. Very fast, sometimes stuns.

skills.name: Static Shield
skills.desc: A crackling shield that shocks whatever hits it.

skills.name: Charge Up
skills.desc: Your next few seconds of spells all crit.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.desc: Lightning that jumps to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.desc: A boom that throws enemies away from you.

skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.desc: A floating ball that zaps nearby enemies.

skills.name: Stone Fist
skills.desc: Hurl a fist of rock. Knocks enemies back.

skills.name: Earth Wall
skills.desc: Raise a wall of stone around yourself.

skills.name: Tremor Sense
skills.desc: Feel footsteps through the floor. Shows every mob nearby on your map.

skills.name: Quake
skills.desc: Shake the ground. Everything falls over.

skills.name: Spike Field
skills.desc: Stone spikes erupt and pin enemies in place.

skills.name: Boulder
skills.desc: A huge rolling rock.

skills.name: Water Lash
skills.desc: A whip of water. Leaves enemies Wet (lightning loves this).

skills.name: Bubble Shield
skills.desc: A bubble that soaks hits and slowly heals you.

skills.name: Purify Water
skills.desc: Make clean water from nothing. Quenches thirst and heals a little.

skills.name: Riptide
skills.desc: A whirlpool that drags enemies in.

skills.name: Tidal Wave
skills.desc: A wall of water that sweeps everything away.

skills.name: Spring Rain
skills.desc: A gentle rain that heals over time.

skills.name: Raise Skeleton
skills.desc: A skeleton climbs out of the floor and fights for you.

skills.name: Bone Armor
skills.desc: Plates of bone wrap around you.

skills.name: Siphon
skills.desc: Steal health from a target.

skills.name: Corpse Blast
skills.desc: Make the nearby dead explode. Messy.

skills.name: Death Grip
skills.desc: Hands from the floor hold enemies and drain them.

skills.name: Bone Storm
skills.desc: A spray of sharpened bones.

skills.name: Mend
skills.desc: Close wounds with a word.

skills.name: Radiant Shield
skills.desc: A dome of light that absorbs damage.

skills.name: Flare
skills.desc: A bolt of blinding light. Undead hate it twice as much.

skills.name: Sunburst
skills.desc: A ring of light that burns the wicked.

skills.name: Blessing
skills.desc: Everything goes a bit better for a while.

skills.name: Guardian Wisp
skills.desc: A friendly light that fights beside you.

skills.name: Hex Bolt
skills.desc: A curse in a bolt. Hexed enemies take more damage.

skills.name: Jinx Ward
skills.desc: A ward that bounces bad luck back at attackers.

skills.name: Bad Luck
skills.desc: Everything nearby starts missing. A lot.

skills.name: Withering
skills.desc: A patch of curse that rots whatever stands in it.

skills.name: Evil Eye
skills.desc: A look that hurts.

skills.name: Curse of Rags
skills.desc: Their armour falls apart. Spiritually.

skills.name: Haste
skills.desc: Everything you do is faster.

skills.name: Rewind
skills.desc: Undo the last few seconds of damage.

skills.name: Slow Field
skills.desc: A bubble where time crawls.

skills.name: Time Bolt
skills.desc: A bolt that ages what it hits.

skills.name: Stopwatch
skills.desc: Stop time around you for a moment.

skills.name: Paradox
skills.desc: Be somewhere else. You were always there.

skills.name: Spore Cloud
skills.desc: A cloud of choking spores.

skills.name: Barkskin
skills.desc: Your skin hardens into bark.

skills.name: Forage
skills.desc: Find something edible. Somewhere. Probably.

skills.name: Thorn Volley
skills.desc: A fan of poisoned thorns.

skills.name: Root Snare
skills.desc: Roots burst up and hold enemies.

skills.name: Regrowth
skills.desc: Moss grows over your wounds.

skills.name: Elemental Brand
skills.desc: Imbue your weapon with fire. Every swing burns.

skills.name: Arcane Parry
skills.desc: A magical guard. Your next parry window is huge.

skills.name: Blink Step
skills.desc: Teleport a short way, slashing as you arrive.

skills.name: Arcane Blade
skills.desc: A wave of force off your blade.

skills.name: Spellstrike
skills.desc: A blow charged with magic. Stuns.

skills.name: Arcane Missiles
skills.desc: A burst of homing-ish force bolts.

skills.name: Wrench Smash
skills.desc: A big two-handed wrench swing. Stuns.

skills.name: Pipe Dream
skills.desc: Dive into the pipes and pop out further ahead.

skills.name: Plunger Guard
skills.desc: Hold up a plunger. Somehow it blocks things.

skills.name: Burst Pipe
skills.desc: A jet of high-pressure dirty water.

skills.name: Drain Clean
skills.desc: Spin the snake. Everything nearby gets unclogged.

skills.name: Emergency Call-Out
skills.desc: Double-time rates. Double-time effort.

skills.name: Defib
skills.desc: Clear! Shocks and stuns. Also revives you once per floor.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.desc: Bandages, antiseptic, a lollipop.

skills.name: Adrenaline
skills.desc: A shot of something strong.

skills.name: Triage Tent
skills.desc: A tent where you heal over time.

skills.name: Sedative Dart
skills.desc: A dart that makes enemies very, very slow.

skills.name: Crash Cart
skills.desc: Hide behind a crash cart.

skills.name: Pipe Bomb
skills.desc: Lob a homemade bomb.

skills.name: Garage Chemistry
skills.desc: Mix cleaning supplies. Do not breathe.

skills.name: Blast Jump
skills.desc: Blow yourself out of trouble. Mostly.

skills.name: Cluster Bomb
skills.desc: One bomb that becomes four bombs.

skills.name: Proximity Mine
skills.desc: Leave a present on the floor.

skills.name: The Big One
skills.desc: Everything you have, all at once.

skills.name: Extraction
skills.desc: A precise pull. Huge crit chance. Keep the teeth.

skills.name: Novocaine
skills.desc: You don’t feel a thing.

skills.name: Drill Rush
skills.desc: Dash in with the drill whining.

skills.name: Floss Garrote
skills.desc: Minty, and causes bleeding.

skills.name: Gas and Air
skills.desc: Enemies get giggly, then slow, then asleep.

skills.name: Root Canal
skills.desc: The worst procedure in the dungeon.

skills.name: Repossess
skills.desc: Snatch something they’re holding. Sometimes it’s loot.

skills.name: Tow Hook
skills.desc: Hook an enemy and yank them closer.

skills.name: Paperwork Shield
skills.desc: A clipboard of legal notices. Somehow deflects blows.

skills.name: Final Notice
skills.desc: A red envelope. It hurts to read.

skills.name: Slip Away
skills.desc: You were never here.

skills.name: Liquidate
skills.desc: Everything must go.

skills.name: Pressure Gun
skills.desc: A pump-action pellet gun. Your basic shot.

skills.name: Fumigate
skills.desc: A poison cloud. Hits pests extra hard.

skills.name: Bug Bomb
skills.desc: Lob a fogger. Everyone gets fogged.

skills.name: Sprayer
skills.desc: A wide spray of something that smells awful.

skills.name: Glue Board
skills.desc: Sticky. Very sticky.

skills.name: Hazmat Suit
skills.desc: Zip up. Nothing gets in.

skills.name: Naughty List
skills.desc: Mark an enemy. Marked enemies take 30% more damage.

skills.name: Sack Slam
skills.desc: Swing the sack. Everyone nearby wants a word with you.

skills.name: Padded Suit
skills.desc: It’s mostly padding. It works.

skills.name: Hot Cocoa
skills.desc: Warm, sweet, restorative.

skills.name: Sleigh Rush
skills.desc: Ho ho ho. Out of the way.

skills.name: Lump of Coal
skills.desc: For the naughty. Thrown hard.

skills.name: Baton Strike
skills.desc: A practised baton blow. Stuns.

skills.name: Rounds
skills.desc: Walk your rounds. Every mob nearby shows on your map.

skills.name: Flashlight
skills.desc: Shine it in their eyes. They stumble.

skills.name: Tripwire
skills.desc: A wire across the floor. Classic.

skills.name: Taser
skills.desc: Ten thousand volts. Mostly legal.

skills.name: Shadow Patrol
skills.desc: Move through the dark like you own it. You do; you’re security.
